Description:
  Analyze GPX files: distance, elevation, stops, and more

Usage:
  gpx-analyzer [command] [options]

Options:
  -f, --format <format>  Output format: text or json [default: text]
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --version              Show version information

Commands:
  analyze <files>   Analyze GPX files: distance, elevation, speed, pace, stops
  split <file>      Split a GPX file by time interval
  merge <files>     Merge multiple GPX files into one
  benchmark <file>  Run multi-configuration benchmark on a GPX file
